    hello!

    i'm janvi, a senior at UC Berkeley studying cognitive science and political economy, which is really a fancy way of saying i'm curious about why people choose what they choose. that curiosity is what pulled me into marketing, especially brand strategy, creative direction and consumer insights.

    i was born in calcutta, india, spent five years at a boarding school in dehradun, came to berkeley as an international student, and most recently studied abroad in coimbra, portugal, traveling wherever i could along the way. what i love most about all of it is immersing myself in new cultures and the stories each one tells. at some point, i realized that every time i share those stories, i'm doing what marketing does best: telling a story people want to be part of. that's also why i'm drawn to events and experiences: they turn an idea into a moment people can actually feel, and i love seeing what clicks and what doesn't.

    when i'm not busy making those moments happen, i'm usually adding to a never-ending TBR list, catching up on bollywood gossip, thrifting, wandering through museums, or on partiful, planning my next event (or finding one to go to). and if you can't find me there, check the nearest café: i'll be the one with a chai and a very long to-do list :,)
